name: invoke-griffar-discard-plus-bp
about: Invoke (Standard activation; Standard manual 'FAQ on Effects' Q11: the part before the arrow is paid in full first, or the effect is not used): Griffar (26RSD01-007, LV1 1 core 5000 BP) '[LV1-2] (During Attack) {{Invoke|Flash}} (Once Per Turn) Discard a "Windfang" family card from your Hand > During this battle, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.' Griffar attacks and Yarisquid (BS31-066, LV1 7000 BP) blocks: in the Flash Timing the player discards Gen-Bor (26RSD01-002, Windfang) and Griffar has 8000 BP for this battle, so it wins. Not usable again this turn, not usable while Griffar is not attacking, and not usable with no Windfang card in the Hand (Goon-Gata 26RSD01-005 is Windfang, the deck card BS31-066 is not).
